title: Hussain veeran main, teri nagri chon beh-ridha turpayee
body:
Teri maqtal naal putaraan dhay sadaa abaad raway main apni nasal muqaakeh bekhataa tur payee
<<DIVIDER>>
Tun naatiqay qur’aan aye
main waarisay thath-heer aan
Tun bekafan aye jeevayn rasiyaan’ch main aseer aan
Teri mayat chaakay pataraan dhay vichon dafanaayee naa
Aye hasarat lehkay rondhi inamaa tur payee
<<DIVIDER>>
Qatiyaan raghaan toh tarpay
Awaaz aye Jali dhi
Shah ragh toh main saneray
Kawaan Kasam Ali dhi
Main thakayaa naal bachray dhay zibaa
edhi maa hoyee
adhay ghal thay ghal katwaakay Fatima tur payee
<<DIVIDER>>
Chan veer dhay ijazat
ban ghazi shaam jawan
Laj tere sajdayaan dhi
Baazaaran wich bachaawan
Mera wadhaa naal abid dhay fathaa teri howaygi
Siro nangayaan bhayn bachawan la ilaa tur payee
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas jeh mur oandaa
Dariyaa dhay paasay jaakay
Karday zulam naa chadaraan
loghi Siiraan toh laakay,
hath rasiyaan naal bhena betiyaan bharjayaan dhay
Teray qatal dhay chashmay dheedh hun gawaah tur payee
<<DIVIDER>>
Akbar dhi laash chumkay
phuphiyaan neh vayn payeh
sughra nu koi jaakay
peghaam ay pohnchaayeh
odhaa akbar laakay sehray moht dhay
jadh samayaa si
Fer Zainab shaam dhay paasay raasiyaan paa tur payee
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir be Juram thay hamsheer baykhata se
Shabbir be kafan si hamsheer be rida si
Rab janay kewein samar bhirawan di laashan nu
Meri bibi ahk Keh rondhi alvida tur payee
